Parking & Transportation

results.name: Seymour Dance: The Nutcracker
results.description_without_html:
Seymour Dance Presents: The Nutcracker
Celebrate the magic of the holiday season with Seymour Dance’s beloved annual production of The Nutcracker!
A cherished North Shore holiday tradition, this enchanting ballet brings together over 200 dancers of all ages, alongside professional guest artists, to tell the timeless story of Clara’s magical Christmas Eve adventure.
From the excitement of the Christmas party to the dazzling Land of Sweets, audiences will be transported into a world of beautiful dancing, festive costumes, and Tchaikovsky’s unforgettable music.
Proudly serving the North Shore community since 1965, Seymour Dance is delighted to bring generations of dancers together on stage and share the joy and wonder of this holiday classic with families year after year.
Join us for a magical performance that is sure to delight audiences of all ages and create lasting holiday memories!
This event is RESERVED SEATING.If you would like to book accessible seating, please contact the box office at 604-984-4484.

results.name: VanDusen Botanical Garden - December 2026
results.description_without_html:
VanDusen Botanical Garden is a 55-acre oasis in the heart of Vancouver with over 7,500 plant species and varieties from around the world! Spot and photograph local wildlife, find your way through an Elizabethan hedge maze, unwind in a serene setting, dine on the patios of Truffles Cafe or Shaughnessy Restaurant, or browse the garden-themed gift shop. VanDusen has something for everyone to enjoy!
These tickets are for general admission only, and cannot be used for special events including, but not limited to Sakura Days Japan Fair and VanDusen Festival of Lights.

results.name: Undergraduate Research Opportunities 2026/27 Membership Sale
results.description_without_html:
Thank you for signing up to be a URO member for 2026/27! As a URO member, you will have access to a range of programs and events hosted by URO to help you get involved in research.
Membership Options

If you are interested in the Research EXperience Program (REX), please purchase the $10 membership - REX Mentee Deadline has passed.
If you are not planning to apply for REX, you may purchase the $5 membership. 
Both tiers: Exclusive research related opportunities and information, including URO Newsletter, Workshops, apply to participate in Research Involvement Fair and MORE

As per AMS bylaws, memberships must be purchased annually and are non-refundable.
How to Receive Your URO Number
After purchasing your membership, please complete the URO Membership Qualtrics Survey as soon as possible. The survey should take approximately 2–3 minutes to complete.
When completing the survey:

Enter the same email address you used when purchasing your membership through Showpass. You will not receive your URO number if the email addresses do not match.
Enter your Showpass invoice id as confirmation of payment
Your invoice id can be found in the confirmation email in the Receipt pdf

Once you have completed the survey, you can expect to receive your URO number within 24–48 hours. We will do our best to send it as soon as possible. Please keep your URO number in a secure place, as you will need it to access all URO membership-based programs and events.
If you do not receive your URO number within 48 hours, or if you have any questions or concerns, please contact us at uro.ubc@gmail.com. You can also talk to us at Clubs Day.
Important Information About REX
Getting a URO membership+REX ($10) does not guarantee that you will become a REX mentee. REX is a competitive program, and all prospective REX mentees must apply through the REX application form. If accepted, you will be matched with a mentor to participate in the program.
For all REX-related questions, please contact our REX Chairs at rex.uro.ubc@gmail.com.
We look forward to having you as part of URO!

results.name: Fistful of Crime: An Improvised Hong Kong Gangster Film
results.description_without_html:
Dive headfirst into the seedy underworld of triads, violence, and all the dumplings you can eat in Fistful of Crime!
In this one-of-a-kind improv show, you'll experience the hallmark gangster cinema from 80s and 90s Hong Kong, reimagined and remixed on-the-spot by Vancouver's premiere East Asian improv group, Fistful of Kicks.
Each show is equal parts drama and comedy, exploring characters caught between the criminal world and polite society, stretched thin between their gang allegiances and their family bonds. All created entirely on the spot based on a single word from the audience! If you're a seasoned HK cinema aficionado, or have no idea what any of those words you just read meant, you'll have a killer time at this show.
Also featuring hilarious opening acts from all around the Vancouver comedy scene. Embrace your inner gangster at Fistful of Crime!
This show will be presented in the Salazar Stage (Main floor).
This show is produced and curated under a rental model, independent of Little Mountain Gallery. If you have questions or comments on this performance please contact the producer at curt.dasilva@gmail.com
Accessibility
Please note that the venue has two separate spaces, upstairs and downstairs. All show listings should indicate which room they’re in on the description. Please ensure you note the location as both spaces do not have the same level of accessibility. 
The front entrance has power assisted doors. 
There’s a powered lift from street level to the main performance space. For more information on the limitations of our lift, please check out our website. 
The venue has six private washrooms on the main floor, one of which is fully accessible with a power assisted door. The theatre doors to the main space are not power assisted at this time. The second floor is not accessible and is up two flights of stairs.
We encourage patrons requiring wheelchair seating message us ahead of performances so we can arrange seating at niki@littlemountaingallery.ca
